goal: Real-conveyor pick cell as a CHAIN SOURCE: a real ConveyorBelt_A09 feeds a cube to an EndStop pick-zone, a downstream Franka picks it and delivers it onto an OPEN flat HandoffTray surface (pickable by a downstream chain receiver), NOT a deep bin. Identical to the proven CP-CONV-02 except the deep Bin -> flat tray so the handoff is chainable.
thoughts: CP-CONV-02 delivers into a deep Bin (not chainable: a receiver cannot pick from inside a deep container, compose_handoff rejects it). To make the real-conveyor cell a chain SOURCE, deliver onto an OPEN flat tray at handoff height so the next stage's arm can grasp it top-down.
code:
# CP-CONV-02-SRC (cont.319hh): CP-CONV-02 as a CHAIN SOURCE -- delivers the belt-fed cube onto an OPEN flat
# HandoffTray surface (pickable by a downstream receiver) instead of a deep Bin. Everything else is identical to
# the proven CP-CONV-02 (lowered A09 conveyor + downstream Franka + EndStop feeder).
create_prim(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", prim_type="DomeLight")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", attr_name="inputs:intensity", value=1000.0)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Ground", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, -0.5], scale=[20, 20, 1])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Ground", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
set_physics_scene_config(config={"enable_gpu_dynamics": False, "broadphase_type": "MBP"})

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Conveyor", prim_type="Xform", position=[0.0, 0.0, -1.0])
add_reference(prim_path="/World/Conveyor", reference_path="/mnt/shared_data/isaac-sim-assets-complete-5.0.0/Assets/Isaac/5.0/Isaac/Props/Conveyors/ConveyorBelt_A09.usd")
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", schema_name="PhysicsRigidBodyAPI")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", attr_name="physics:kinematicEnabled", value=True)
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", schema_name="PhysxSurfaceVelocityAPI")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", attr_name="physxSurfaceVelocity:surfaceVelocity", value=[0.2, 0.0, 0.0])
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", attr_name="physxSurfaceVelocity:surfaceVelocityEnabled", value=True)
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", attr_name="physxSurfaceVelocity:surfaceVelocityLocalSpace", value=True)

create_prim(prim_path="/World/EndStop", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.03, 0.0, 0.82], scale=[0.01, 0.45, 0.05])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/EndStop", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Pedestal", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.5, 0.0, 0.375], scale=[0.15, 0.15, 0.375])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Pedestal", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

robot_wizard(robot_name="Franka", dest_path="/World/Franka", position=[0.5, 0.0, 0.75], orientation=[0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0])

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", prim_type="Cube", position=[-0.02, 0.0, 0.806], size=0.05)
for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
    apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name=api)
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
bulk_set_attribute(prim_paths=["/World/Cube_1"], attr="physxRigidBody:sleepThreshold", value=0.0)
apply_physics_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", material_name="rubber")

# CHAIN-SOURCE delivery: an OPEN flat tray (top ~0.78) on a support pedestal, instead of CP-CONV-02's deep Bin.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/TraySupport", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.5, -0.5, 0.375], scale=[0.2, 0.2, 0.375])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/TraySupport", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
create_prim(prim_path="/World/HandoffTray", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.5, -0.5, 0.76], scale=[0.34, 0.34, 0.04])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/HandoffTray", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

add_proximity_sensor(sensor_path="/World/PickSensor", position=[0.0, 0.0, 0.85], size=[0.08, 0.08, 0.14])

setup_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/Franka",
    target_source="curobo",
    sensor_path="/World/PickSensor",
    belt_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt",
    source_paths=["/World/Cube_1"],
    destination_path="/World/HandoffTray",
    planning_obstacles=["/World/EndStop", "/World/HandoffTray"],
)

CHAIN VERIFIED: chain_xkit_gate CP-CONV-02-SRC CP-CHAIN-FLAT = 1/1 + 1/1 ALL DELIVERED (the real-conveyor cell feeds a cube to the tray handoff @0.825; CP-CHAIN-FLAT receiver picks the relayed cube -> its bin).
